name: geoventure-launcher-rust
description: Launcher Geoventure moderne en Rust (Tauri v2)

scripts.dev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust-env.ps1 npx tauri dev
scripts.build: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust-env.ps1 npx tauri build
scripts.build:release: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust-env.ps1 cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:rust: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust-env.ps1 cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:rust: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust-env.ps1 cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
